description.value: The Fort Nelson Public Library serves this remote northern BC community at the heart of Municipal Square, offering a broad range of programs and digital services well beyond a typical small-town library. Located along the Alaska Highway corridor, it is a notable waypoint for long-distance cycle tourists in one of the most isolated stretches of the province. The library provides free public internet access, a seed library, meeting rooms, and an unusually rich roster of community programming.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms the library is active with a current events calendar. Phone (1-250-774-6777), email, and core address all match OSM. Wi-Fi is confirmed via both OSM internet_access=wlan tag and the website's dedicated 'Computer & Internet Use' service page listing public computers and internet access. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null.
concerns: Website address includes unit 'A2' and 'PO Box 330' not present in OSM address field — same physical location but OSM entry could be more precise.
Services page contains the phrase 'Our Internet access is kindly donated by Fort Nelson Public Library' which appears to be a self-referential template error; does not affect data reliability.
No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information found on website — these remain unconfirmed rather than absent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fort Nelson is one of the most remote waypoints on the Alaska Highway cycling corridor; the library offers confirmed free Wi-Fi and a full suite of public services, making it a genuinely useful and welcoming stop for long-distance touring cyclists passing through this isolated region.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A public library is more accurately a services/waypoint stop than a tourist attraction; however, in the remote northern BC context it serves as a meaningful cyclist waypoint and the category is acceptable as-is.

wow_evidence: Active library at Municipal Square; ordinary library band.
blurb: Fort Nelson's public library at the heart of Municipal Square.
